gates.title: all 25 runtime markers in the declared order
runtime BEGIN and supplied ELF agree
every required operation actually reports ok
child-side cancellation cleanup is actually observed

scope: A runtime transcript is distinct from the atomic-cell guest. Native execution does not qualify BE execution. A supplied ELF hash binds bytes, not their compiler/source provenance. The supplied revision is an operator claim, not an attestation. Analysis only validates supplied transcript bytes; command exit and execution custody require the original execution receipt. This runner compiles nothing. Synthetic checker tests are not runtime or QEMU proof. A guest pass covers the named phases under the recorded QEMU kernel, not stock kernels, 32 MiB memory fit, physical drivers/audio, provider integrations, or completion of P05/P03.
